title: Health Education and Promotion (DPH1318): Main Exam, Wed 12th Nov, 2025 2.00pm
department: Department of Community Health and Biostatistics

items.text: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 4 MARKS
Define the term health education and explain its importance in community health.
Differentiate between health education and health promotion with suitable examples.
Explain four key concepts of health education that guide effective learning and behavior change.
Describe four ethical principles that should guide health promotion practice.
Discuss four participatory approaches that can be used in health education programs.
Explain four advantages of community participation in health promotion.
Discuss four major models used in health education and how they apply in public health.
Describe four strategies commonly used in health education and promotion interventions.
Explain four steps involved in evaluating a health education program.
Identify four factors that may hinder effective implementation of health promotion strategies in Kenya.
ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 15 MARKS
Discuss in detail the relevance of models of health education in planning, implementation, and evaluation of health promotion programs.
Describe the various stages involved in the planning and evaluation of a health promotion intervention, providing relevant examples.
Critically analyze the importance of ethics and community participation in the success of health education and promotion activities.
